answer: Each identity locks a 70-credit bond and registers a lantern post for a voyage. Each epoch the beacon sends a random lantern signal at a random minute; the watcher must file a signed report in 10 minutes with the vessel's onyx seal serial and signal. An auditor checks it against the registry; a late, wrong, or reused serial burns the bond. One operator answers one signal per minute, so simultaneous signals miss: the kth fake pays 12+9(k-1); 1,000 pay 4,507,500 and lock 70,000. A rented-watch ring fails: hired hands add no minutes; an honest watcher pays 12 once, bond back after a clean epoch.
